fields.label: About this schedule
fields.text:
SECTION 1 IS THE SCHEDULE AS AT THE EFFECTIVE DATE OF THIS REVISION. It is generated from the verification schedule the site maintains in the Team Portal, so the two cannot disagree at the point this document was issued.

The live schedule is at Compliance → Verification Schedule, and that is where an activity is added, retired or re-timed. A change there needs a revision of this form; the annual review of the Validation and Verification Programme is the occasion that catches it.

Activities marked NOT YET IMPLEMENTED are scheduled but are not being performed — the programme that governs them has not been issued. They raise no reminders and no entry is expected against them.

fields.label: Master verification schedule
fields.help: Every verification activity, its frequency and the position responsible (SQF 2.5.2.2).

fields.label: When to use this section
fields.text:
SECTION 2 IS ONE ENTRY PER VERIFICATION ACTIVITY PERFORMED, where no other record already covers it — for example the annual review of critical food safety limits, or an assessment of a change.

WHERE THE ACTIVITY HAS ITS OWN RECORD, USE THAT RECORD AND NOT THIS ONE. The monthly GMP inspection is FRM-913; sanitation verification is FRM-902; the temperature review is FRM-401; the retention review is FRM-703. Filling in both would create two accounts of one activity.

THE VERIFIED BY SIGNATURE IS THE AUTHORIZATION 2.5.2.1 REQUIRES. A verification that leaves no signature is indistinguishable from one that did not happen.

fields.label: Activity
fields.help: As named on the schedule above.

fields.label: Frequency as scheduled
fields.help: Copy from the schedule above, so the record shows what was expected.

fields.label: Period covered
fields.help: For example September 2026, or week ending 2026-09-07.

fields.label: What was examined, and against what criteria
fields.help: Records, areas, equipment or limits looked at, and what a satisfactory result would be.

fields.label: Result
fields.help: Fail means the control was not effective or was not carried out. Finding one is a success for the verification.

fields.label: Findings
fields.help: What was found. Record 'none' rather than leaving it blank.

fields.label: FRM-007 reference
fields.help: The CAPA number, where one was raised.

fields.label: Performed by
fields.statement: I carried out this verification activity as recorded above.

fields.label: Verified by
fields.statement: I have reviewed this record and authorize it.
